scope.cancellationCompatibility: UPGRADED CANONICAL CANCELLATION TO CONSUME W4-C1 EFFECTIVE ALLOCATION
scope.v2SealedCancellation: RELEASES HIGHEST SEALED CURRENT-EFFECTIVE SNAPSHOT FROM canonical_reservation_revision_nights
scope.singleVersionReleased: EXACTLY ONE EFFECTIVE ALLOCATION VERSION RELEASED
scope.releaseHeaderEvidence: SNAPSHOTS released_effective_version (INT NOT NULL) AND released_revision_id (UUID, NULL FOR V1, FK FOR V2+)
scope.releaseNightEvidence: PERSISTS room_type_id AND EXACT released_units (UNITS > 1 SUPPORTED)
scope.underflowRollback: ALL-OR-NOTHING: INSUFFICIENT BOOKED UNITS ON ANY NIGHT ROLLS BACK TRANSACTION COMPLETELY
scope.replayIdempotency: EXACT REPLAY RETURNS STORED COMMITTED RESULT WITHOUT RE-RELEASING INVENTORY

migration.strategy: Additive schema extension on canonical_reservation_cancellation_inventory_releases and canonical_reservation_cancellation_release_nights; replace canonical_complete_reservation_cancellation function with version-aware semantics preserving exact accepted signature

effectiveAllocationSource.resolutionMechanism: canonical_reservation_effective_revisions view resolving distinct highest committed/sealed version
effectiveAllocationSource.unsealedHandling: Unsealed revisions (status ASSEMBLING) are excluded by view criteria and never released

releaseHeader.released_revision_id: UUID NULLABLE (NULL for V1; foreign key referencing canonical_reservation_revisions(id, reservation_id) for V2+)
releaseHeader.checkConstraint: chk_cancellation_release_version_revision enforcing ((released_effective_version = 1 AND released_revision_id IS NULL) OR (released_effective_version >= 2 AND released_revision_id IS NOT NULL))

releaseNights.released_units: INT NOT NULL CHECK (released_units > 0) representing exact snapshot units

durableEvidenceSnapshots.historicalBackfill: Existing release headers safely backfilled with released_effective_version = 1 and released_revision_id = NULL; release nights backfilled with room_type_id from canonical_reservations under temporary trigger disable

atomicityAndReplay.deterministicLockOrdering: inventory_days locked ORDER BY calendar_date ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE OF day prior to mutation
atomicityAndReplay.allOrNothing: If booked_units < units_to_release on any effective day, throws INVENTORY_RELEASE_UNDERFLOW; entire transaction rolls back with zero state changes
atomicityAndReplay.replayVerification: canonical_reservation_lifecycle_commands receipt verified; returns replayed = true with stored release_id and event_id; zero inventory re-decrement

immutability.releaseHeader: canonical_reservation_cancellation_inventory_releases_immutable trigger rejects any UPDATE or DELETE
immutability.releaseNights: canonical_reservation_cancellation_release_nights_immutable trigger rejects any UPDATE or DELETE
immutability.w4c1RevisionModel: W4-C1 revision, revision nights, and seal tables remain completely immutable and read-only to cancellation execution

rolePrivilegeBoundary.encho_cancellation_executor: Has EXECUTE on canonical_complete_reservation_cancellation (SECURITY DEFINER); ZERO table permissions on canonical_reservation_revisions, canonical_reservation_revision_nights, or canonical_reservation_revision_seals
rolePrivilegeBoundary.encho_cancellation_issuer: Has EXECUTE on canonical_issue_cancellation_decision_authorization; ZERO table permissions on revision or release tables
rolePrivilegeBoundary.runtimeRolesAssemblyAuthority: ZERO runtime roles have INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or seal authority on revision tables

casesVerified: A. V1 cancellation releases version 1 original nights: released_effective_version = 1, released_revision_id = NULL
B. V2 cancellation releases sealed V2 snapshot: released_effective_version = 2, released_revision_id = V2 ID
C. V2 cancellation does NOT release OLD_ONLY V1 inventory
D. NEW_ONLY V2 inventory is released
E. UNCHANGED V2 allocation released once
F. units > 1 decremented exactly: units = 2 decrements exactly 2, release evidence records 2
G. sealed V2 + unsealed V3 releases V2: unsealed V3 completely ignored
H. highest sealed revision selected: sealed V2 + sealed V3 releases V3
I. V2 later-night underflow rolls back entire cancellation: zero decrements, zero receipts, lifecycle remains CANCELLATION_REQUESTED
J. V2 exact replay does not re-release inventory: returns replayed = true with identical IDs
K. release receipt stores exact effective version/revision evidence
L. release-night evidence stores exact units, room_type_id, and inventory identity
M. revision and seal rows remain completely untouched by cancellation
N. cancellation executor has zero V2 assembly/seal write permissions
O. zero modification writer in pg_proc
P. zero financial or payment side effects
